ma.request(Object object)

Initiate an HTTPS network request.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
url String Yes Developer server API address.
data String/Object/ArrayBuffer No Request parameter.
header Object No Set the request header. Referer cannot be set in the header. The default value of content-type is application/json.
timeout Number 60000 No Timeout duration, in milliseconds.
method String GET No HTTP request method.
dataType String JSON No Returned data format
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)
preload Function No The interface calls the prefetch data callback function (for specific usage, please refer to Data Prefetch)
Valid Values of object.method
Value Description
GET HTTP GET method.
POST HTTP POST method.
PUT HTTP PUT method (supported only by iOS).
DELETE HTTP DELETE method (supported only by iOS).
Valid Values of object.dataType
Value Description
JSON The returned data is JSON. After returning, JSON.parse will be performed on the returned data.
Other The returned content will not be JSON.parse
object.success Callback Function
Parameter
Object res
Attribute Type Description
data String Data returned by the developer server.
statusCode Number HTTP status code returned by the developer server.
object.preload Callback Function
参数
Object res
Attribute Type Description
data String Data returned by the developer server
statusCode Number Prefetch Data Status Code
errMsg String Prefetch success or failure details
Prefetch data status code comparison table
statusCode Description
0 Prefetch succeeded.
0607001 url is Not exsit
0607002 parameter mismatch
0607003 request failed: ${errMsg}
0607004 fetchData is empty
0607005 invalid preload rule

Sample Code

ma.request({
  url: 'http://example/testUrl',
  timeout: 5000,
  header: {
    'content-type': 'application/json',
  },
  data: {},
  method: 'GET',
  success: function(res) {
    console.log(res);
    console.log('request success');
  },

  fail: function(res) {
    console.log('request fail', res.errMsg);
  },
  preload: function(res) {
    console.log(res.data)
  }
});

Bug & Tip

  1. tip: Currently, the security domain is not verified. You are advised to use HTTPS.
  2. tip: The HTTPS certificate is not verified. The certificate verification capability needs to be provided in the MacleEventHandler interface implementation.
